lines.en: You look worried today. What is wrong?
lines.ko: 오늘 걱정이 있어 보여요. 무슨 일이에요?

lines.en: I'm a little nervous. My son is far away.
I see. Do you miss him?
Yes, a lot. I felt lonely last night.
Did you call him?
I called him this morning. He is fine.
That's good. Don't be sad. He is safe.
Thank you. Talking with you takes away my stress.
Any time. Will you come for tea tomorrow?
Yes, I will. I'm not worried now.
lines.ko: 네, 갈게요. 이제 걱정 안 돼요.

lines.en: Hello. Are you okay? You look sad.
My best friend moved away last week.
lines.ko: 제일 친한 친구가 지난주에 멀리 이사 갔어요.

lines.en: I'm sorry. You must miss her a lot.
I do. I cried a little this morning.
Don't be lonely. I'm right next door.
lines.ko: 외로워하지 마요. 제가 바로 옆집에 있어요.

lines.en: Thank you. That is kind of you.
Will you call her tonight?
Yes, I will. I'm nervous, but I will try.
lines.ko: 네, 할 거예요. 긴장되지만 해 볼게요.

lines.en: Good. Are you free for tea now?
lines.ko: 좋아요. 지금 차 한잔 할 시간 있어요?

lines.en: Yes! I'm not so sad now. Thank you.
lines.ko: 네! 이제 그렇게 슬프지 않아요. 고마워요.
